# TopLinkers | Real Estate, Turnkey Construction & Solar Islamabad

> TopLinkers Real Estate, Construction & Solar is an authorized real estate agency, PEC-licensed turnkey builder, and Tier-1 on-grid solar net metering provider headquartered in G-11 Markaz, Islamabad, Pakistan. Specializing in verified CDA/RDA plots, PHA executive apartments in I-12 and I-16, Harsukh Residencies luxury vacation suites in Nathia Gali, turnkey Grade-60 steel villa construction, and IESCO bi-directional solar net metering.

## Core Services & Portfolios

- [Verified Property Listings](https://toplinkersgroup.com/listings): Browse verified residential plots, commercial plots, PHA executive flats in Sector I-12 & I-16, and luxury villas with 100% legal title verification.
- [Moqa Ka Plots & TopCity-1](https://toplinkersgroup.com/property/corner-plot-topcity): Immediate cash possession plots in TopCity-1, PECHS, and Faisal Town Phase 2 with clean transfer and underground utility clearance.
- [PHA Executive Flats I-12 & I-16](https://toplinkersgroup.com/listings?category=pha-flats): Ready possession 2-bed and 3-bed apartments in Islamabad with dual elevators, standby power, and clean CDA registry.
- [Harsukh Residencies Nathia Gali](https://toplinkersgroup.com/hr-sukh): Hillside luxury studio, 1-bed, and 2-bed vacation suites in Kuza Gali / Nathia Gali on 3-year installments with 20%+ projected annual rental yields.
- [Turnkey Construction & Solar Net Metering](https://toplinkersgroup.com/services): PEC-licensed grey structure and full turnkey house construction, plus complete 10kW to 50kW Tier-1 solar systems with IESCO green meter net metering.
